insights.one_liner: DLA Piper is a global law firm with an Amsterdam office; an IND sponsor with an English-language entry-level finance job.

culture.text: Global law firm with offices across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia Pacific, working on cross-border deals and disputes.

open.text: DLA Piper Nederland N.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, an entry-level finance role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Has been adding partners abroad, such as an insurance team in Peru and investment funds partners in New York and Toronto.

worth_knowing.text: Faces scrutiny for joining Trump's legal team after urging his removal over January 6 in 2021.
